scientific_change: Learned per-head polynomial kernels p_{l,h}(s) = sum_{r<=m} c_{l,h,r} s^r, m = 1-4, initialized at the Taylor values 1/r!, over QK-norm cosine scores s = exp(gamma_{l,h}) cos(q, k) with gamma learned per layer and head from log(sqrt(d_K)); run without row normalization (fused kernel) and with signed row-sum normalization (blocked reference, the first normalized learned polynomials in the repository); canonical selective weight decay

softmax_canonical_decay.note: The repository's single softmax baseline since main commit 4601633 (formerly experiments/decay_policy_baseline).

softmax_original_decay_retired.note: Retired from the repository in main commit 4601633 (run, checkpoint, and log removed); the value survives only in attention_scaling_comparison's frozen original-decay copy.
